Leadership | Gusto

Meet the team building payroll, benefits and HR for small businesses.

Executive Team

Renata Okafor
Chief Executive Officer
Renata joined Gusto in 2019 after a decade scaling finance teams. She lives in Denver with her two kids.

Samuel Whitfield
Chief Financial Officer
Sam previously ran FP&A at a public SaaS company and is a CPA.

Ines Carvalho-Mendes
VP, People & Culture
Ines leads our people team across Denver, San Francisco and New York.

Kwame Asante
VP of Sales
Kwame built our mid-market sales motion from zero to hundreds of reps.

Departments

Engineering
Danielle Fortier — SVP Engineering
Before Gusto, Danielle led infrastructure teams at two fintech startups.

Marketing
Oliver Park — Head of Brand Marketing

Want to join us? See open roles at gusto.com/careers
